high light scattering by solid and dispersed samples, which enables measurements using diffuse reflectance

Feasibility trials on representative granulate samples are required to determine empirical performance, and commercial pricing will follow separately.

assessment.chemometrics_note: NIR moisture prediction relies on multivariate calibration (e.g., PLS regression) with scatter correction preprocessing such as Standard Normal Variate (SNV) or Multiplicative Scatter Correction (MSC) to suppress physical particle size variations.
assessment.realtime_tracking_note: Fiber-optic diffuse reflection probes provide continuous, high-speed acquisition suited to tracking dynamic drying trajectories in granulators or fluid bed systems.

proposal.what_would_change_it: Severe probe fouling or mechanical abrasion would favor the non-contact standoff configuration (O1).
proposal.next_step: Conduct feasibility trials on representative granulate samples paired with primary laboratory reference testing to determine true empirical accuracy.

assessment.brief_answer: Written confirmation of plus or minus 0.1 % accuracy cannot be issued prior to testing, and regulatory approval cannot be promised by an instrument vendor. Diffuse reflectance NIR is the recommended technique to evaluate for granulate moisture, but quantitative performance depends on matrix-specific chemometric calibration against primary laboratory data. Feasibility trials on representative granulate samples are required to determine empirical performance, and commercial pricing will follow separately.
